topic: A 5th anonymous frontier model just dropped on OpenRouter — 1M context, video input, $0 for a week. The last 4 of these were all Chinese labs. Either it's a launch strategy, or someone really doesn't want to be named.

concept: A single unmarked matte black server tower in deep dark void, one thin strip of crimson light bleeding from a horizontal vent crack near the base, four smaller ghost-silhouettes of identical towers receding into pitch-black perspective behind it. The '5th' is the vivid crimson-lit tower in the foreground; the four ghosts behind it are the previous four anonymous drops — the pattern is visible in a single glance. The crimson accent is the only color in a void of pure black, echoing the China pattern without leaning on stereotype; the absence of branding, model name, or maker-mark on the tower IS the anonymity. Hard chiaroscuro rim lighting + volumetric haze = bold on-platform mood for 16:9 Twitter. No text, no logos, no human likeness — the geometry carries the whole hook.
